text:
Mira: quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A. need single-source plan so marketing/docs/legal don't get surprised. owners + gates for: adaptive batching (API), per-route cost visibility (Console), Optimize suggestions (UX).
Sam: owners: adaptive batching -> Noor/eng-runtime, cost view -> Kai/billing+console, suggestions -> Priya/optimize.
Noor: short tech note: adaptive batching touches decoder scheduling and cache evictions. we will need a safe fallback path for Dedicated orgs.
Priya: Optimize ask: initial canary shows suggestions only, feedback widget + opt-in retention required for metric collection. target retention 60 days for canary cohort.
Kai: billing ask: per-route numbers are "derived estimates". we'll show an "Estimated" badge and a download link to raw tagged usage CSV for reconciliation.
Mira: can we get firm canary windows? marketing needs embargo dates.
Noor: propose adaptive batching canary 2024-06-25 (48h), expanded beta 2024-07-23.
Kai: console internal preview 2024-07-10, public preview 2024-07-31.
Priya: Optimize suggestions UI canary 2024-07-05, review after 2 weeks.
Sam: infra asks: Dedicated pinned-model orgs must opt-in to migration; infra will add a console toggle `allow_autolift_migration`. migration off by default.
Noor: SDK snippet we will publish: `client.configure({batching:{mode:'adaptive',target_latency_ms:20,min_batch:3}})`. we'll add a clear migration guide re: ordering.
Raj: telemetry gating: require p95 regression <=7% and error-rate spike <= 1.25x baseline across canary slice. KV cache miss rate must not increase >2%.
Priya: UX gating: suggestions UI must have feedback widget + a visible "beta" badge, and a feedback opt-in checkbox in org settings.
Kai: data gating: backend tags must be stable for 72h before internal preview. also need a short tooltip copy explaining "Estimated vs Export". Kai -> I'll draft.
docs-bot: docs request: please attach a sample route.json and token_profile.csv to DOCS ticket. docs will produce reproducible screenshots once sample is attached.
Mira: embargo/comms: marketing wants a one-week embargo between internal preview and public mention. can we align dates?
Sam: yes. we'll schedule internal preview windows with at least 7 days buffer.
Noor: deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled: prod-canary/batching 2024-06-25 02:00 UTC. health checks: p95, error-rate, KV-eviction-rate. auto-rollback if error-rate >1.25x baseline.
deploy-bot: note: canary window 48h, metrics posted to eng-sre channel.
Mira: action list (owners):
- Noor: publish migration guide + sample route by 2024-06-18.
- Kai: draft tooltip copy + CSV export flow by 2024-06-20.
- Priya: implement feedback widget + opt-in flow by 2024-06-22.
- Sam/infra: add Dedicated migration toggle and confirm load-test schedule by 2024-06-17.
- Docs: generate screenshots from samples and hand to marketing by 2024-06-27.
Noor: note: adaptive batching does not change tokenization or semantics, but request ordering can differ in rare cases. we'll highlight in breaking notes.
Priya: we'll collect qualitative feedback during canary and include a short survey in the widget.
Mira: thanks all. I'll compile a short post-all-hands summary with these items and ping owners Monday. if anything slips, update the thread. :thumbsup:
